leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement an Express.js endpoint to evaluate feature flags
Construct a feature flag configuration object with boolean values
Apply conditional logic to return different responses based on flag states
Configure route parameters to accept feature flag keys in requests
Initialize a basic feature flag service module with evaluation logic
Manipulate HTTP response objects to return JSON flag evaluation results
Integrate the feature flag endpoint into an existing Express application structure
